incidents.text: It's a goal! Felix Nmecha (Germany) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box into the right side of the target. The assist goes to Florian Wirtz and the score changes to 1:0.
Goal! Livano Comenencia (Curacao) gets a shot away from inside the box and the effort is deflected past the goalkeeper. 1:1.
Gooal! Nathaniel Brown takes over corner duties. Nico Schlotterbeck (Germany) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
Kai Havertz (Germany) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
Goal! Kai Havertz (Germany) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Eloy Room into the bottom left corner.
Here is a change after the half-time break. Sontje Hansen is replaced by Jeremy Antonisse (Curacao).
Goal - 4:1! Joshua Kimmich laid the ball off to Jamal Musiala (Germany), who shot from close range into the bottom left corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
The substitution is prepared. Deniz Undav (Germany) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jamal Musiala.
Dick Advocaat has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jearl Margaritha (Curacao) replacing Jurgen Locadia.
What a goal! Deniz Undav plays it to Nathaniel Brown (Germany), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Eloy Room into the bottom right corner. 5:1.
The substitution has been made. Antonio Rudiger (Germany) has replaced Jonathan Tah.
Here's the change. Felix Nmecha (Germany) leaves the pitch and Leon Goretzka comes on as a substitute.
The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and David Raum (Germany) is coming onto the pitch as Nathaniel Brown cannot continue after picking up an injury.
What a goal! Joshua Kimmich plays it to Deniz Undav (Germany), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Eloy Room into the left side of the goal. 6:1.
The manager makes a subsitution with Gervane Kastaneer (Curacao) coming on for Tahith Chong.
Here is a change. Joshua Kimmich is going off and Julian Nagelsmann gives the last tactical orders to Waldemar Anton (Germany).
GOAL - 7:1! Deniz Undav found Kai Havertz (Germany) inside the box, he spotted goalkeeper Eloy Room off his line and chipped the ball into the net. What a cheeky lob!
